evidence.snippet: We present JamSet and JamBench, the first project-level game code framework dataset and benchmark built on a professional game engine.

claire_radar.motivation: Current AI-driven game development has made substantial progress in asset generation, gameplay design, and web-based game coding, yet project-level code engineering on professional game engines remains largely unexplored due to the absence of large-scale datasets and deterministic evaluation methods.
